subject.title: fix: inject only shared auth into macos dashboard

question: Should macOS Dashboard browser auth be shared-token/password only, or may it inject native device/operator tokens for parity with native clients?
rationale: The linked issue asks to keep native device tokens out of browser Control UI auth, while the sibling issue and PR ask for native-token parity; the repository needs one auth boundary before either branch can land safely.

options.title: Adopt shared-token-only browser auth
options.body: Proceed with this policy, close or retarget the conflicting parity path, and require this PR to rebase over current Dashboard endpoint reload behavior with proof.

options.title: Keep native-token parity
options.body: Pause or close this PR and continue with the sibling parity direction after security review confirms native device tokens are acceptable in browser Control UI auth.

options.title: Defer the policy
options.body: Keep both PRs open as drafts until a macOS/auth owner writes the permanent Dashboard browser-auth contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared-token-only browser auth
recommendation.body: Proceed with this policy, close or retarget the conflicting parity path, and require this PR to rebase over current Dashboard endpoint reload behavior with proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current Dashboard endpoint-reload path and is the strongest observed owner for deciding how this auth policy should integrate with it.
